findings.F1: The tested short is on the predicted side but small, and it does not grow with narrowness. The mean short-signed unusual 18-bar move is +0.56 % (t 1.74, 670 cases). The narrowest quartile of stretches gives +1.01 % (t 1.15) and the widest +0.29 % (t 0.44). The Spearman correlation between narrowness and the move is -0.015, and the larger-minus-smaller forecast split is -0.17 %. So more t alone would still leave the supporting check failing.
findings.F2: The effect is mixed across the data. By coin it runs from LTC at -1.62 % (t -2.05, 94 cases) to XRP, ZEC and XMR at +1.32 % to +1.69 % (t 1.77 to 1.86). By year, 2018 alone gives +5.07 % (t 4.06, 63 cases), while 2020 and 2021 give -1.21 % and -1.22 %. Much of the mean rests on one year.
findings.F3: The short does not pay its cost and turns against itself with time. The total short move is +0.14 % per case against a 0.19 % round trip (0.7 times the cost). The short's total move is +0.15 % at 1 day, -0.14 % at 6 days (651 cases) and -0.74 % at 10 days (621 cases). Over these 6 coins' windows the normal 18-bar drift is +0.24 % to +0.60 %.
findings.F4: The clear effect is on the other side and graded by the stretch's width. Take every downward break (close below the prior 12-bar low) in a rising 30-day month, one per 18-bar cell, 932 cases. When the prior two-day stretch was wide, the coin rises over the next three days:
findings.F5: This width-rebound gradient is broad and large next to cost. The Spearman correlation between stretch width and the long unusual 3-day move is +0.13 overall and positive in all 6 coins (+0.04 to +0.25). It is positive or zero in 7 of 8 years, the exception being 2021 at -0.02. In the widest quartile the total rise grows from +1.11 % at 1 day (t 2.64) to +4.02 % at 6 days (t 4.38, 223 cases). Over 3 days the total rise is about 14 times the 0.19 % cost, and the unusual move about 11 times.

ideas.name: quiet breakdown, more coins
ideas.idea: When a four-hour bar closes below the lowest low of a coin's preceding two-day narrow stretch, the coin falls over the next three days, and the narrower that stretch was compared with the coin's 30-day average four-hour range, the larger the fall, only while the coin's 30-day return is positive.
ideas.consequence: Short a downward break out of a narrow range only in a coin that has risen over the past month, and refuse the short in a falling month, where the drift and the rebound eat it.

ideas.idea: When a four-hour bar closes below the lowest low of a coin's preceding two-day stretch while the coin's 30-day return is positive, the coin rises over the next three days. The wider that stretch was compared with the coin's 30-day average four-hour range, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: In a coin that has risen over the past month, buy a break below a wide two-day range rather than short it, and refuse the short most firmly when the broken range was wide.
ideas.name: wide breakdown rebound uptrend
